name: Saif Rohyal
title: Full Stack AI Engineer
headline: I build AI agents and the full stack products around them.
bio: I'm Saif Rohyal. I build autonomous, multi-agent AI systems with LangGraph, LangChain, OpenAI Agents SDK, CrewAI, AutoGen and MCP, backed by Python and FastAPI. I have built five end-to-end AI projects, from an e-commerce ops agent to a voice booking assistant, and I am looking for a job, remote role or startup where I can keep building AI products end to end.

responsibilities: Designed and built multi-agent AI workflows with LangGraph and LangChain, with specialised agents coordinated by a supervisor agent.
Developed Python and FastAPI backend services to expose AI agent features through APIs.
Connected agents to external tools and data sources using MCP (Model Context Protocol) and automated workflows with n8n.
Prototyped and tested AI assistants (such as voice and customer-support agents), refining prompts and agent behaviour based on test results.

projects.title: Smart AI Recognition System
projects.description: Real-time visual recognition engine that detects, classifies and identifies objects, faces and scenes, with confidence scoring, custom model training and API access.
projects.metrics: Sub-50ms inference latency for object detection streams
projects.architecture: Edge capture -> Ingestion API -> Model inference pipeline -> Bounding box & confidence tagging -> WebSocket stream

projects.title: Autonomous E-Commerce Ops Agent
projects.description: Specialised agents monitor product listings, write SEO descriptions, adjust prices from demand signals, handle customer queries and flag inventory issues, coordinated by a supervisor agent.
projects.metrics: Multi-agent coordination reducing routine listing updates from hours to minutes
projects.architecture: Supervisor Agent -> [Catalog Agent, Pricing Agent, Customer Support Agent, Inventory Sentinel] -> Tool execution via MCP

projects.title: Autonomous Research & Experiment Agent
projects.description: Reads papers and docs, forms hypotheses, writes and runs code experiments in a sandbox, evaluates results, self-corrects on failures and produces a structured research report.
projects.metrics: Automated iterative hypothesis verification loops with self-correcting error recovery
projects.architecture: Document Parser -> Hypothesis Formulator -> Sandbox Code Runner -> Output Evaluator -> Self-Correction Loop -> Report Generator

projects.title: AI Customer Support Copilot
projects.description: Support platform with an AI copilot that drafts replies from company docs, remembers past tickets, escalates edge cases and gives agents a live knowledge panel, with analytics on deflection and CSAT.
projects.metrics: Context-grounded retrieval with live ticket sentiment tagging and escalation triggers
projects.architecture: Frontend Ticket Workspace -> FastAPI Ingestion -> RAG Embedding Search -> Copilot Draft Generator -> Live CSAT Telemetry

projects.title: Voice Booking Assistant
projects.description: Conversational voice agent that handles calls, checks availability and books appointments automatically.
projects.metrics: Real-time bidirectional audio streaming with sub-second response latency
projects.architecture: Audio In -> Streaming STT -> LangGraph Intent Router -> Availability Engine -> Streaming TTS -> Audio Out
